blocks.text: Aaj pani ki bachat intehai ahem hai kyunke duniya ka bara hissa pani ki qillat ka shikar hai. Neeche diye tareeqe pani bachane mein madad dete hain:

items: Zaraat mein pani bachane wali technology, jaise drip aur sprinkler aabpashi, jo zayaa bohat kam karti aur fasal ki paidawar aur kaarkardagi barhati hai.

Greywater (kapre dhone, bartan dhone aur nahane ka pani) ko baghbani, toilet flush aur sanati thandak ke liye dobara istemal aur recycle karna, jo taza pani bachata aur sewage ki safai ka bojh kam karta hai.
Shehri aur dehi ilaqon mein barish ka pani jama karne (rainwater harvesting) ke nizam, pani pakarne aur jama karne ka pa-idar tareeqa.
Pani ki farahmi ke nizam ki ba-qaida marammat aur dekh-bhaal, taake rasao aur pani ka zayaa kam ho.
Chhote dam aur recharge wells, jo barish ka pani jama karte aur zameeni pani dobara bharte hain, aur khushk mausam mein qabil-e-aitbar farahmi dete hain.
Muashre ki shirakat aur aagahi: pani bachane ki aadaton par awami taleem aur aabi zakhiron ki hifazat mein maqami logon ki shamooliyat.

blocks.prompt: Pani ki bachat ke chaar tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi chaar: drip ya sprinkler aabpashi; greywater ka dobara istemal; barish ka pani jama karna; rasao ki marammat; chhote dam aur recharge wells; awami aagahi muhimmein.

items: Drip aur sprinkler aabpashi; greywater ka dobara istemal; barish ka pani jama karna; rasao ki marammat; chhote dam aur recharge wells; aagahi.
